4.title: Month 1 Dashboard — End of Week 4
4.obj: Did I build a stable foundation in self-introduction, project updates, blocker explanation, clarification questions, and pronunciation awareness?
qs: Can I explain who I am and what I do clearly?
Can I give a project update without getting lost?
Can I explain a blocker with structure?
Do I still sound translated or stiff?
Which 3 speaking weaknesses are most urgent next month?

8.title: Month 2 Dashboard — End of Week 8
8.obj: Did I improve technical-to-business explanation, recommendations, professional disagreement, and sprint/stakeholder meeting performance?
qs: Can I explain technical work in business language?
Can I recommend a solution instead of only describing a problem?
Can I disagree professionally without sounding weak or defensive?
Am I more useful in meetings than four weeks ago?

12.title: Month 3 + Final Dashboard — End of Week 12
12.obj: Can I now perform credibly in real professional conversations?
qs: What is now clearly stronger than 12 weeks ago?
In what speaking situations do I still lose control?
What pronunciation issues still show up repeatedly?
Which 20 phrases are now part of my active speech?
What should the next 12-week cycle focus on?
